footguns.summary: Lowering Black Hole cooldown before Golden Tower is synced makes a 1:1 GT/BH sync more expensive.
footguns.detail: Community guides recommend saving stones and dropping GT cooldown to match BH (often 3:20 / 200s) in one session rather than upgrading BH cooldown alone.

footguns.summary: Changing any ultimate weapon cooldown can break strategies that rely on UW timing.
footguns.detail: Several farming and devo strategies require specific GT/BH/DW/SM sync ratios. Review target syncs before spending stones on cooldown.

footguns.summary: Prioritize natural GT/BH sync (often 200s / 3:20) instead of relying on Multiverse Nexus long term.
footguns.detail: MVN averages cooldowns and can reduce UW uptime until later module levels. Community guides still push toward natural sync even while MVN is equipped.

footguns.summary: Bot cooldown lab upgrades are permanent — desyncing bots from Golden Tower hurts farming synergies.
footguns.detail: Guides suggest syncing bots (excluding Flame Bot) to UW cooldowns, often at half of GT/DW sync CD in 5–10 second steps.

footguns.summary: Defense Absolute is flat reduction — past early game, Defense %, Health, and Wall Health usually outperform it per coin.
footguns.detail: Flat reduction trims less relative damage as enemy attack scales with tiers, so marginal eHP per coin often trails percentage mitigation paths.

footguns.summary: Chrono Field Range zooms the camera out, slightly lowering CPH because enemies spawn farther away.
footguns.detail: The CPH trade-off is usually small and tournament benefits often outweigh it; most accounts still max the lab eventually.

build_archetypes.summary: Health build focuses on HP scaling for early-to-mid progression.
build_archetypes.detail: Best for newer and mid-game accounts still climbing tiers; pair Health with Defense % for efficient eHP.

build_archetypes.summary: Orb Devo needs GT/BH sync and BH Size of at least 38m.
build_archetypes.detail: Community Orb Devo guides assume synchronized Golden Tower and Black Hole with sufficient BH Size for devo placement.

build_archetypes.summary: SMAX Devo expects GT/BH/Smart Missiles cooldown sync.
build_archetypes.detail: Mid-game SMAX guides rely on Smart Missiles timing with GT and BH for devo setups.
